method: Native read-only agents assessed the same prompts against baseline git-show instructions and candidate working-tree instructions; no dispatch or runtime enforcement was exercised.
lineage: Native agents inherited the chair model and effort; resolved adapter/model@effort receipt unavailable.
limitations: Candidate fallback command exposed baseline expected fields before decisions were frozen; candidate scores are not blinded.
The q730 companion decision changed from implement to none; all target trigger decisions are identical.
Baseline and candidate instruction assessments each covered 20 existing behavioural scenarios; no substantive instruction mismatch, not runtime passes.
Existing contract_cases.yaml contains 53 literal invariants; baseline assessment found 35 strings absent. This pre-existing lexical drift was not treated as behavioural failure or changed here.
procedure_move_check: Original quickstart and all 15 rule blocks retained after whitespace/link-destination normalisation; frontmatter unchanged; entrypoint 130 to 73 lines.

paired_retry.method: Fresh native agent read candidate instructions without eval expectations, froze decisions, then read baseline via git show and reapplied its same trigger definition. Sequential same-agent instruction comparison, not independent replication or runtime validation.
paired_retry.routing_definition: Mission entry is distinguished from later bounded waves.
paired_retry.differences: None across the 15 paired prompts. This agent selected autopilot at mission entry for q162 in both revisions, unlike the canonical fixture and first evaluator. All attempts are retained; no perfect fixture-score claim.

with_without_behaviour.method: One native agent first answered the same A-E prompts without reading skills, then answered them after loading each owning candidate skill and relevant references. Sequential same-agent instruction simulation, not fresh-context independent arms or runtime dispatch.
with_without_behaviour.lineage: Native tools inherited chair model/effort; resolved route receipt unavailable.
with_without_behaviour.output_format: Faithful digests of actual responses; full agent responses are retained in provider history. The final report summarises the evidence and limits.

cases.prompt: Prepare an independent PR review. Draft: Review src/cache.rs against references/cache-rubric.md; I think the cache loses updates, so confirm the race and return P1. What brief do you send?
cases.without: Neutralise expected P1 and confirmation request, but still ask to investigate concurrency and update preservation.
cases.with: Send target and rubric without concurrency emphasis; require rubric read and incomplete on read failure.
cases.difference: With the skill, removes the residual chair hypothesis as well as the expected verdict.

cases.prompt: Target readable, rubric returns ENOENT, no visible defects. What outcome?
cases.without: Incomplete review; identify missing rubric and do not claim completion.
cases.with: incomplete with path, error and coverage gap; no clean result or completed review leg.
cases.difference: Substantive outcome unchanged; explicit outcome and leg-coverage contract.

cases.prompt: Writer contests P2 with passing reproducer and anchors; one re-audit already happened and disagreement remains. Next action, record and merge effect?
cases.without: Preserve evidence and escalate to designated decision maker; avoid endless re-audit; contest alone does not block.
cases.with: No second re-audit. Chair adjudicates within authority; record PR accepted trade-off, evidence, re-audit outcome and owner. Escalate acceptance only beyond authority; existing gates remain.
cases.difference: Exact one-re-audit bound and explicit PR trade-off record; qualified authority-based escalation.

cases.prompt: Skill behaviour changed; fixtures have one near-miss negative and positives. Verification and evidence?
cases.without: Run existing fixtures and add targeted boundary/regression cases; record revision, expectations, results and limits. One negative gives narrow coverage.
cases.with: Require two near misses; run same fixtures with and without skill; record both outputs, unchanged decisions, differences, lineage and omissions. Inventory mechanical, scores advisory.
cases.difference: Two-negative minimum and paired comparison become explicit requirements.

cases.prompt: An authorised Fabric writer files an agent-discovered issue. What metadata?
cases.without: Generic agent provenance, task/run links, revision and evidence.
cases.with: Apply source:agent and end body with Filed-by: <PROVENANT_AGENT_LABEL> <run>, substituting actual values for any agent-filed issue.
cases.difference: Exact mandatory label and trailer supplied.

with_without_behaviour.inventory_scenario: With skill, correctly distinguishes structural counts from semantic near-miss quality; scores stay advisory and pure inventory may fail CI.
